author: Widogeist
body: Anguished gear drops will have the maximum amount of adornment slots readily available, even though the item itself may only be level 1.  Both the T9 and T10 feathers have 16 adornment slots when godforged, however, since this item is anguished you already have all 16 slots available. Upgrading the item will further increase the stats (att, ward, etc) however you won't gain any additional adornment slots.
